Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the attached Requestman macOS design into a revised production-quality high-fidelity UI screenshot. Produce ONE screen, not multiple alternatives. Target 1440 x 1024 desktop viewport, same visual style and typography as attached. Current date 2026-09-24 if needed; avoid timestamps on this editor.

PRESERVE: light native macOS feel, subtle cool-gray sidebar, white workspace, thin separators, refined blue selection, teal request path and muted purple response path, compact 14–16px typography, technical monospace, small precise native controls, traffic lights and Requestman wordmark. Keep side-by-side request and response step lists with right step inspector. No new visual identity, large cards, promotional copy, decorative graphics, browser frame or desktop wallpaper. Full app fills image.

USER REQUIRED INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE: The primary organization is projects/folders. Each project contains multiple REQUEST MODIFICATIONS, and each request modification owns exactly one request-and-response workflow. Execution history is GLOBAL across ALL projects and modifications, and is a peer of the modification editor, not a subsection of a project or a small recent-execution panel within a workflow. Environments are NAMED GROUPS of values (dev with apiKey, cookie, baseURL; staging another set), switch the whole environment, not a single variable.

REMOVE completely: any mention of Surge, upstream server/route/port display, sentence 'Chrome Network 将显示处理后的响应', and all recent-execution drawer/panel in the editor. No other filler instructions.

This is the requested revision of the attached screen.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE new high-fidelity macOS Requestman GLOBAL EXECUTION HISTORY screen, matching the attached revised flow-editor screen EXACTLY in visual language and shell. This is a companion screen in the same app, not an alternative concept. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024. Date anchor 2026-09-24; any rows dated today use that exact day. One screenshot only, full app viewport, no collage, no device or wallpaper.

Style reference is the attached Requestman flow editor. Preserve white/cool-gray surfaces, SF Pro-like typography 14–16px, SF Mono-like technical text, native macOS traffic lights, blue selected states, subtle hairlines, restrained teal/purple semantic colors, compact expert-tool spacing. No decorative dashboard or large cards, no background grid, no giant metric tiles. Design a focused actionable execution-records table and selected record's execution trace.

INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE: Execution records are a GLOBAL PEER of Request modifications and Environment management. They aggregate all configured request-modification workflows in all projects. Do NOT put history inside a project folder or within a flow. No project tree sidebar on this screen; project is a filter and table column. Each request modification owns one workflow; multiple records can come from the same workflow. Environment dev/staging is a named GROUP of variable values (apiKey, cookie, baseURL). Current environment switch and historical environment filter are distinct.

BODY: full width below nav. Upper heading row left '执行记录' with quiet small '今天' alongside; right light controls pause icon '暂停记录' and trash icon '清空'. These are about recording, not flow execution.
